programs.title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part 1
programs.desc: A struggling comedian's love for a doctor deepens, while his loyal best friend finds himself entangled with a free-spirited woman. When tragedy strikes the group, they're forced to rebuild and transform their bond from friendship into chosen family.

programs.desc: A struggling comedian's love for a doctor deepens, while his loyal best friend finds himself entangled with a free-spirited woman. When tragedy strikes the group, they're forced to rebuild and transform their bond from friendship into chosen family.

programs.title: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy
programs.desc: Val is a devoted but lonely wife who feels like she's becoming emotionally distant from her husband, Ross. While visiting her pregnant daughter in New Orleans, she meets a charismatic photographer who sees her in ways she's forgotten to see herself.

programs.title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
programs.desc: Al and Lisa Robertson's relationship becomes strained under the weight of betrayal and unspoken pain. With their marriage and faith hanging by a thread, both must decide if love is worth fighting for, and what it truly means to forgive.

programs.title: When I Said I Do
programs.desc: A widowed K-9 handler remains reluctant to open her heart again, until she meets a rescue specialist with a past of his own. As their connection deepens into something real and healing, they must decide whether they have the courage to choose love.

programs.title: Love, Again
programs.desc: Caroline and Henry's nearly perfect life shifts dramatically when Henry is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's disease. As her soulmate gradually slips away, Caroline soon finds unexpected solace when she develops a friendship with Leo.
